failure_modes: Adopting a temporal teacher/attention recipe (C008-C011) without validated observed-node advantage risks unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates and constraint violation with no affinity benefit.
Changing teacher_neighbors (C005/C007) treats a count as a distance bandwidth and may degrade mode coverage without dispersion evidence.
Interpreting a temporal derivative as a spatial gradient would misdirect coordinate control and is not supported by the supplied evidence.
result.rationale: D1.2: The offered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009/C010/C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change teacher coordinates or regional attention, not merely dose; the static incumbent uses teacher_score_beta=0 and no temporal recipe. Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0 and continuous:2) shows sign changes and rate reversals with no accepted polynomial and no extrapolation permitted, so a time-conditioned rule is not defensibly better than the stationary coordinate target within the observed window [0.0,0.5]; a temporal derivative is not a spatial gradient and cannot be read as a coordinate reward direction. D2.2: teacher_neighbors is a count, not a distance bandwidth; the incumbent already uses 4 (C006), and the offered narrower (C005=2) or broader (C007=8) neighborhoods have no supplied dispersion or joint-geometry evidence establishing better mode coverage or resolving competing directions, so neither is defensibly preferred. D4.1: No registered edit shows a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent: pointcloud_delta_A is already 1.0 A (C002), region_index 0 (C004) is the incumbent default, and the temporal/neighbor alternatives lack supporting evidence. D4.2: The predicted failure of an unsupported edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates (violating the max_atom_step_A=0.15 and max_cumulative_rms_A=6.0 constraints) without affinity benefit, since coordinate graph changes alone are not a failure mechanism and the objective is affinity-first. Retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported choice; the decision would change only if a registered choice showed a validated advantage on observed nodes within the window.
